items.title: 10.6 Induced emf aur Faraday ka qanoon (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.6 with Figs. 10.13 and 10.14 (PDF 238-240); sign and cross-reference findings recorded.

blocks.text: Tajrubati taur par dekha gaya hai ke jab conductor magnetic field ke aar paar chale to us ke siron ke darmiyan electromotive force (emf) paida (induce) hoti hai. Chalte conductor mein induced emf battery jaisi hai: agar conductor ke sire taar se jor kar band circuit banaya jaye to us mein current behta hai.

blocks.title: Motional emf
blocks.text: Magnetic field ke aar paar conductor ki harkat se paida hone wali emf motional emf kehlati hai.

Fig. 10.13 ka tajruba lein. Lambai L ki conducting rod do mutawazi dhaati patriyon (rails) par rakhi hai jo L faasle par hain. Patriyon ke siron c aur d ke darmiyan galvanometer jora hai, jis se mukammal conducting loop abcda banta hai. Yaksan magnetic field B kaghaz ke andar ki taraf hai. Shuru mein, jab rod saakin ho, galvanometer koi current nahi dikhata. Agar rod ko mustaqil velocity v se daen taraf khincha jaye to galvanometer loop mein current dikhata hai. Zahir hai ke current magnetic field ke aar paar rod ki harkat se paida hua; chalti rod emf ka source hai, epsilon = Vb - Va = delta V.

blocks.alt: Do ufuqi patriyan (rails), oopar sira c aur neeche sira d, baen taraf galvanometer se juri hain. Tanbe ki rod ab (b oopar, a neeche) un ke aar paar hai; darmiyan hare hisse mein cross batate hain ke B kaghaz ke andar hai. Rod mein charge q velocity v se daen chalta hai. Current I ke teer: oopar wali patri par baen, galvanometer ke saath neeche aur neeche wali patri par daen. L patriyon ka faasla hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.13: Motional emf: kaghaz ke andar wali magnetic field mein patriyon par v se chalai gayi rod (kitab ki Figure 10.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rod daen chal rahi hai aur B kaghaz ke andar hai, is liye rod ke musbat charges par force q v x B a se b ki taraf (oopar) hai. Current rod mein oopar, oopar wali patri par c ki taraf baen, galvanometer se neeche aur neeche wali patri par daen behta hai: yani loop abcda mein anticlockwise.

Jab rod chalti hai to us ke andar charge q bhi usi velocity v se field B mein chalta hai aur force F = q v x B (Eq. 10.13) mehsoos karta hai, miqdar qvB sin theta. Chunke v aur B ka zawiya 90 degrees hai, F = qvB ... (10.16). Right-hand rule se q par force rod ke saath a se b ki taraf hai, to charges oopar ke sire b par jama hote hain jabke neeche ke sire a par charge ki kami hoti hai. Charge ki yeh nayi tarteeb b se a ki taraf electrostatic field E banati hai, aur charge par b se a ki taraf electrostatic force qE. Nizam jaldi aisi tawazun ki halat mein aa jata hai jahan yeh dono forces barabar hain: qE = qvB, ya E = vB ... (10.17).

Is tawazun mein motional emf rod ke siron ke darmiyan potential difference delta V = Vb - Va ke barabar hai. Kitab field ko potential gradient ka manfi likhti hai, E = -delta V/L ... (10.18), jis se delta V = -LE = -(LvB) aur epsilon = delta V = -LvB ... (10.19); is ki miqdar vBL hai. Agar v aur B ka zawiya theta ho to epsilon = -vBL sin theta ... (10.20). Induced emf ki wajah se musbat charges raste abcda par behte hain, to diagram mein induced current anticlockwise hai. Current behne se oopar ka charge kam hota hai, jis se electric field ghatti hai jabke magnetic force wahi rehti hai; yeh adam-tawazun magnetic force ke haq mein hai, to circuit se sire a tak pohanchne wale charges magnetic force se wapas oopar ke sire b tak le jaye jate hain, aur current behta rehta hai.

Magnetic field ke amudi chalti rod mein motional emf epsilon = -vBL hai. Motional emf aur doosri induced emfs magnetic flux ke zariye bayan ho sakti hain. Fig. 10.14 ka tajruba lein: rod chhote waqt delta t mein position 1 se position 2 tak faasla delta x = x2 - x1 tay karti hai. Chunke yeh mustaqil velocity se chalti hai, v = delta x/delta t ... (10.21). Ise Eq. 10.19 mein rakhne par epsilon = -vBL = -(delta x/delta t) BL ... (10.22). Rod ke delta x chalne se loop ka raqba delta A = delta x L barhta hai, jo loop se flux delta phi = (delta A) B barhata hai. Eq. 10.22 mein (delta x L) B = delta phi rakhne par epsilon = -delta phi/delta t ... (10.23).

blocks.alt: Wahi patriyan aur galvanometer; rod Position 1 par dashed aur Position 2 par solid. Neeche x1 galvanometer wale sire se Position 1 tak, delta x Position 1 se Position 2 tak, aur x2 galvanometer wale sire se Position 2 tak. Dono positions ke darmiyan ki patti delta A hai; L patriyon ka faasla; current I oopar wali patri par baen; B kaghaz ke andar.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.14: Rod Position 1 se Position 2 tak delta x chalti hai aur loop ka raqba delta A barhta hai (kitab ki Figure 10.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Waqt delta t mein rod delta x = x2 - x1 chalti hai, is liye loop ka raqba delta A = L delta x barhta hai aur flux delta phi = B delta A barhta hai. Isi se emf = -delta phi/delta t nikalta hai.

Equation 10.23 (print mein Eq. 10.20 ka hawala) dikhati hai ke agar ek loop se magnetic flux badal raha ho to flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah ka manfi loop mein induced emf ke barabar hai. N loops wali coil ke liye induced emf N guna ho jati hai: epsilon = -N delta phi/delta t ... (10.24). Agarche yeh motional emf se nikala gaya, yeh aam taur par durust hai. Yeh nateeja sab se pehle Faraday ne nikala, isi liye ise Faraday ka electromagnetic induction ka qanoon kehte hain.

blocks.title: Faraday ka electromagnetic induction ka qanoon
blocks.text: N loops wali conducting coil mein induced ausat emf us sharah ke manfi ke barabar hai jis se coil se magnetic flux waqt ke saath badal raha ho. Manfi alamat batati hai ke induced emf ki simt aisi hai ke flux ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat kare.

blocks.alt: Tanbe ka chhalla positions 1 se 5 tak seedha neeche girta hai. Positions 2 aur 4 mustateel field wale hisse (cross: field kaghaz ke andar) ke oopar aur neeche kinare par hain, aur position 3 us ke andar hai. Position 2 par chhalle ke oopar khamdaar teer anticlockwise, aur position 4 par chhalle ke neeche khamdaar teer clockwise hai.
blocks.caption: Point to Ponder (PDF page 240): Tanbe ka chhalla aise mustateel hisse se guzarta hai jahan mustaqil magnetic field kaghaz ke andar hai; positions 2, 3 aur 4 par chhalle mein current (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Position 2 par chhalla field mein dakhil ho raha hai: andar ki taraf flux barh raha hai, is liye current anticlockwise behta hai taa ke us ki field (kaghaz se bahar) is barhne ki mukhalifat kare. Position 3 par chhalla poora andar hai, flux nahi badalta, current nahi. Position 4 par chhalla nikal raha hai, flux ghat raha hai, is liye current clockwise hai.

Wireless charging electromagnetic induction ke usool par kaam karti hai (Do You Know). Induction heater par dhaati bartan ka pani ubalta hai jabke sheeshe ke bartan ka nahi, aur sheeshe ki oopri sath bhi thandi rehti hai: neeche ki coil mein alternating current hai jo badalta flux banata hai; bartanon se jura flux emf induce karta hai, aur dhaati bartan mein bana current pani garam karta hai, magar sheeshe ke bartan mein current nahi behta, kyunke sheesha insulator hai (Point to ponder).

blocks.prompt: Tanbe (copper) ka chhalla aise mustateel ilaqe se guzarta hai jahan mustaqil magnetic field kaghaz ke andar hai; positions 2 (dakhil hote), 3 (poora andar) aur 4 (nikalte) par chhalle mein current ka kya hota hai (Point to Ponder)? Ek murabba loop yaksan field mein chalta hai aur us ka amud field ke mutawazi hai; kya emf induce hoti hai (short question 10.2)?
blocks.explanation: 2 par chhalle se flux barh raha hai, to current induce hota hai; 3 par chhalla poori tarah yaksan field mein hai, flux mustaqil hai aur koi current nahi; 4 par flux ghat raha hai, to current ulti simt mein behta hai. Murabba loop ke liye yaksan field mein chalte hue flux BA mustaqil rehta hai, to koi emf induce nahi hoti.

blocks.prompt: 15 cm side aur 60 turns wali murabba coil 0.8 T field mein apni satah field ke amudi rakh kar rakhi hai; use 2 s mein 30 degrees ghumaya jata hai. Ausat induced emf nikalein (numerical 10.3).
blocks.explanation: Shuru mein fi turn flux BA = 0.8 x 0.0225 = 1.80 x 10^-2 Wb; ghumane ke baad BA cos 30 = 1.56 x 10^-2 Wb; tabdeeli 2.41 x 10^-3 Wb. Ausat emf = N delta phi/delta t = 60 x 2.41 x 10^-3/2 = 7.2 x 10^-2 V. Print ka jawab, 0.54 V, tabhi nikalta hai jab poora flux, 60 x 1.80 x 10^-2 Wb, 2 s mein khatam ho jaye; yeh jaanch ke liye darj hai.

items: Motional emf: lambai L ki rod v se B ke aar paar; qvB charges ko rod ke saath dhakelti hai jab tak qE = qvB (10.17); emf ki miqdar vBL (print -LvB, 10.19), zawiye par vBL sin theta (10.20); induced current abcda par anticlockwise.

Faraday ka qanoon: emf = -delta phi/delta t (10.23); N turns ke liye emf = -N delta phi/delta t (10.24); manfi alamat ka matlab emf flux ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karti hai. Istemalat: wireless chargers, induction heaters.
